description:
Everything printed on one page of a document, as text. Empty text or an
empty list means "not shown on this page". Never guess a value that is not
printed, and copy numbers exactly.

amounts_include_vat.description: Whether the line amounts on this page include VAT.

carried.description: The page-continuation figures, if this page prints any (ADR-0022).

brought_forward.description:
The amount brought forward at the top of this page, for example "Brought forward",
"Balance brought forward" or "B/F", written like a unit price. Empty if this page does
not print one.

carried_forward.description:
The amount carried forward at the foot of this page, for example "Carried forward",
"Balance carried forward" or "C/F", written like a unit price. Empty if this page does
not print one.

credit_note.description: The credited invoice, if this is a credit note.

amount.description: The credited amount, written like a unit price.

original_invoice_number.description: The number of the invoice being credited, as printed.

currency.description: The currency of the amounts on this page.

due.description: The due date and terms, if printed on this page.

date.description:
The due date as YYYY-MM-DD (South African dates are day/month/year).
Empty if no due date is printed.

terms.description: The payment terms as printed, such as "30 days". Empty if none.

invoice_date.description:
The invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD (South African dates are day/month/year).
Empty if not on this page.

invoice_number.description: The invoice or credit note number as printed. Empty if not on this page.

lines.description: The line items on this page, in order. Empty if none.

line_total.description: The line amount exactly as printed, written the same way.

quantity.description:
The quantity: digits and at most one dot, at most 3 decimals, such as 2 or 1.5.
If the line shows only an amount and no quantity, write 1.

tax.description: How the page shows this line is taxed.

unit_price.description:
The price of one unit exactly as printed: digits and at most one dot, at most 2
decimals, no thousands separators, no currency symbol, a leading minus for
a negative amount, such as 1500.00. Do not add or remove VAT. If only a line
amount is printed, repeat it here.

recipient.description: Who the document is addressed to.

address.description: The address as printed. Empty if none.

name.description: The name as printed. Empty if no party is shown.

vat_number.description: The VAT registration number as printed. Empty if none.

address.description: The address as printed. Empty if none.

name.description: The name as printed. Empty if no party is shown.

vat_number.description: The VAT registration number as printed. Empty if none.

totals.description: The totals, if printed on this page.

gross.description: The total including VAT, written like a unit price. Empty if not printed.

net.description: The total excluding VAT, written like a unit price. Empty if not printed.

vat.description: The VAT amount, written like a unit price. Empty if not printed.

title: PageReading
